title: aralia elata f. aureovariegata
intro: Aralia elata f. aureovariegata, commonly known as Golden Variegated Japanese Angelica Tree, is a variety of flowering plant in the family Araliaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce pain and improve overall health. The therapeutic actions of Aralia elata f. aureovariegata include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain, and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
